Madikeri, Kodagu District, arising out of Crime No.76/2024 registered by Kushalnagar Town Police Station, Kodagu, for offences punishable under Section 406, 420 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code (for short, 'IPC') and Sections 21, 22 and 23 of Banning of Unregulated Schemes Act,

sentences.text:
2. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
3. FIR in Crime No.76/2024 was registered by Kushalnagar Town Police Station, Kodagu, for the aforesaid offences against Rahul Chakrapani and others on the basis of the first information dated 21.10.2024 received from Chandrahas.K.T son of Karigowda.
4.
During the course of investigation of the case, petitioner was arrested on 23.11.2024 and subsequently, remanded to judicial custody.
Investigation of the case is NC: 2025:KHC:15225 completed and the charge sheet has been filed against eight persons.
The petitioner is arrayed as accused No.2 in the charge sheet.
Bail application filed by the petitioner in Crl.Mis.No.429/2024 before the Jurisdictional Sessions Court was rejected on 28.11.2024.
Therefore, the petitioner is before this Court.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is only an employee in the Society and he has no control over the management.
He has fully co-operated with the police for the purpose of investigation.
Similar cases were registered against him in Madikeri, Virajpet and Gonikoppa police stations.
He has been granted regular bail by the Sessions Court in the cases which are registered by Madikeri and Virajpet police stations.
Investigation of the case is completed and charge sheet has been filed.
Accordingly, prays to allow the petition.
6. Per contra, learned High Court Government Pleader has opposed the petition.

He submits that only a preliminary charge sheet has been filed in the present case and therefore, NC:
2025:KHC:15225 petitioner cannot be granted regular bail at this stage.

Accordingly, prays to Shri. Sunny Abraham vs State Of Karnataka on 9 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/24486319/
2 dismiss the petition.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 7. Learned counsel for the petitioner has brought to the notice of this Court that petitioner was earlier serving in the Indian Army and after his retirement, for the last one and half years he has been working in the aforesaid Society known as 'Malabar Multistate Agro Co-operative Society' as CEO.
He is in custody from 23.11.2024.
In the other two cases registered against the petitioner with the similar allegations by Madikeri and Virajpet police station, petitioner has been already enlarged on bail by the Sessions Court.
In the case registered against him by Gonikoppa Police Station, this Court has granted regular bail to him by even date order passed in Crl.P.No.354/2025.
Investigation of the case is completed and the charge sheet has been filed.
Petitioner has undertaken to co-operate with the police for the purpose of further investigation, if any.
The alleged offences are triable by the Court of Magistrate and the maximum punishment for the same is imprisonment for a period of seven years.
Considering the aforesaid aspects of the matter, I am of the opinion that the prayer made by the petitioner for grant of regular bail is NC: 2025:KHC:15225 required to be answered affirmatively.

Accordingly, the following:-
ORDER
The petition is allowed.
